item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 16 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 16 #VISPRSD
Issued at 11:10 PM 15 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OccidentalMindoro(Mamburao, SantaCruz, Sablayan), #Palawan(Coron, Culion, Linapacan, Dumaran, Roxas and Araceli) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:00 PM 15 August 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #Palawan, #OccidentalMindoro, #Antique, #Aklan, #Capiz, #Iloilo, #Guimaras, #NegrosOriental and #NegrosOccidental within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.
